# Brendon Lai — brendonlai.com | 帮中国工业落地东南亚

> Brendon Lai 是中国工业企业进入东南亚的实战顾问。这个网站是个人 IP 枢纽，持续输出关于工业出海、AI 自动化与一人公司运营的实战内容。
> Brendon Lai is a hands-on advisor helping Chinese industry enter Southeast Asia. This site is his personal IP hub, publishing field notes on industrial expansion, AI automation and one-person-company operations.
